title: Research: a GPU notebook in minutes, taken back when idle
purpose: Start a notebook from the golden-path manifest. It must get a GPU through the research queue, keep its files when the idle culler stops it, and give the GPU back.

steps.display: kubectl create -f notebook.yaml   # nb-ana: JupyterLab, 1 GPU, 5 GiB workspace, research queue
steps.output:
statefulset.apps/nb-ana created

Error from server (AlreadyExists): error when creating "STDIN": services "nb-ana" already exists

NAME                       QUEUE       PRIORITY   ADMITTED
statefulset-nb-ana-e0591   notebooks   100        notebooks

steps.display: time from kubectl create to a ready notebook
steps.output: 172 seconds; a GPU node was bought for it: yes

steps.display: kubectl -n research exec nb-ana-0 -- bash -c "echo 'experiment 1 ...' > /workspace/notes.txt; cat ...; df -h /workspace"
kubectl -n platform logs deploy/notebook-culler | grep nb-ana   # the culler's checks (idle limit 120 s in this build; 60 minutes in the design)

steps.output: 139 seconds, with nobody touching the notebook

checks.description: the notebook was admitted through the research queue at opportunistic priority
checks.because: The golden-path manifest carries the queue and priority labels. Kueue turned them into a Workload admitted by the notebooks queue, with the opportunistic class's value (100).

checks.description: the notebook got a GPU and is ready in under 12 minutes
checks.because: When no GPU node is running, one is bought for the notebook, so the time includes the node, the image pull and the JupyterLab install.

checks.description: a GPU is visible inside the notebook container
checks.because: The container requested one nvidia.com/gpu, so the device plugin handed it a device.

checks.description: the workspace is a separate 5 GiB volume
checks.because: A StatefulSet volume claim backs /workspace; it is not part of the container.

checks.description: the idle notebook was stopped automatically
checks.because: The culler asks each Jupyter server when it was last used and scales the StatefulSet to zero past the limit.
Scaling to zero deletes the pod, so Kueue frees the Workload's quota.
Deleting a StatefulSet pod never deletes its volume claim.

checks.description: the file written before the cull is still there after the restart
checks.because: The same volume was attached to the new pod.
